quick_skim.title: ZoomSEM: accelerating large-scale brain connectomics with intelligent SEM super-resolution
quick_skim.abstract: Serial electron microscopy (EM) is essential for large-volume biological imaging and connectomics, yet its throughput remains a major bottleneck, with cubic-millimeter-scale brain imaging requiring months or years. Existing deep learning-based EM super-resolution methods are limited to small upscaling factors or rely on synthetic data, offering modest acceleration and limited practical impact. We introduce ZoomSEM, a deep learning-based super-resolution method to dramatically accelerate SEM imaging. Trained on real low- and high-resolution scanning electron microscopy (SEM) pairs, ZoomSEM enables reliable recovery of 4$\times$, 8$\times$, and up to 16$\times$ higher-resolution images from fast low-resolution scans while preserving fine neuronal structures critical for connectomic analysis, achieving up to 30-fold effective acceleration. Extensive experiments across datasets of diverse biological samples demonstrate robust generalization under realistic low-resolution acquisition. This advance enables high-resolution, large-volume serial EM imaging at unprecedented speed, poised to transform connectomics and related fields.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对大规模脑连接组电镜成像通量低、现有超分辨方法放大倍数有限或依赖合成数据的问题，作者提出基于深度学习的ZoomSEM。方法使用真实低分辨率与高分辨率扫描电镜图像对训练，实现4倍、8倍乃至16倍超分辨率重建。结果能在保持结构细节的同时从快速低分辨率扫描恢复高分辨率图像，从而显著加速大规模脑连接组数据采集。
